# Pull requests are not accepted

Thank you for your interest in the official Science Olympiad scoresheets.

**This repository does not accept pull requests.** Any pull request opened
here will be closed without review.

## Reporting issues or submitting fixes

If you found a problem with a scoresheet or checklist, or have a fix to
suggest, please email [scoresheets@soinc.org](mailto:scoresheets@soinc.org).
Include:

- the event and division (for example, Thermodynamics C)
- the file and, if relevant, the cell or column involved
- what you expected and what you saw
  - giving examples or access to your scoresheet to help give a reproducible
    example
- a suggested fix, if you have one
